objectives.text: Give every form control a programmatically associated visible label, using htmlFor and id or a wrapping label
Indicate required fields and connect each error message to its field with aria-describedby and aria-invalid
Make form-level errors or success perceivable to screen-reader users by moving focus or using a live region

minutes.basis: Measured on the authored artifact.html with the frozen estimator (authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py): P50 8.12 minutes. Worst required path models one additional wrong graded attempt per interactive unit before it settles, at the estimator cost table (1 predict at 30 s, 2 explore at 20 s, 3 terminal_step at 35 s, 1 mcq at 45 s): 11.79 minutes. Budget and about label are 12: the larger of the intake plan of 10 and ceil(max(P50, worst path)), under the 15-minute ceiling (authoring/docs/tools/validators.md). This is a model, not a measurement with learners. Re-synced 2026-11-20 after a learner-text wording pass: estimator P50 8.12 -> 8.16; modeledWorstPath shifted by the same delta (11.79 -> 11.83); budget and aboutLabel unchanged.
